description: Op 7 R_TXM statements (P6-ANON plan §4, D15; pq-zether.md §8.1 op 7): every built (M, auditorOn) of each id with one real leg (123,456) at a position that varies by shape and decoy legs (0), plus a two-real-leg row, an all-decoy row and a group-boundary row (real legs b - 1 and b, b = s ceil(4 / s) with s = S_AUD: the last leg of one audited group and the first of the next). ids: the proofSystemIds whose built leg counts contain M (PQZL {1, 2, 4, 8}, PQZH {1, 2, 4}). header: as statement_transfer.json with word 192 = recipientsHash = keccak256(UA_0 || ... || UA_{M-1}) (32-byte words of objects.uas) and word 320 = M; auditorOn = 1 iff pk_a. objects: keys by KeyGen seed (pks: leg order), T = Enc + Trivial(plus_trivial), out: the multi-group Enc (D13): group g encrypts its legs (j / s = g), then (g = 0) pk_f with value_f, then (auditor on) pk_a once per leg of the group, from seed_enc_g = seed_enc (g = 0) or SHAKE256(SCAAS-PQZ-ENC-GROUP-V1 || seed_enc || be4(g))[0..32), ctr = its counter. memo (§5.4, CTR-PQZ-23): salt || ((u8(auditorOn) || u8(M) || (be8(a_j) || UA_j)_j) XOR ks), key = HKDF-SHA256(IKM key_seed, no salt, info PQZ/memo/v1 || chainUid || token(20) || fromUA || be4(sendCounter) || salt)[32], ks = HKDF-Expand-SHA256(key, PQZ/memo/ks/v1, 2 + 40 M); memoHash = keccak256(memo). memo_open: memo open (the sender's recovery) on edited memos (resize, flip [byte, bit]) of the case, result = (auditorOn, [amount, UA]) or none. stmt = the PQZL-id bytes (PQZH: bytes 32..63 replaced); stmt_keccak / auth_digest per id; entry_ref as op 1. Groups of S_AUD legs with the auditor (set.json s_aud; owner 2026-10-25, R0-1), 4 without: leg j in group j / s, its auditor copy at the coefficients [16 w, 16 w + 16) of pk_a^T r_g, w = j mod s (the group's i-th copy at window i). disclosures: §7.9 statements of op 7 legs (R_DR, the auditor's R_DA): words as statement_disclose.json with the case's chainId, chainUid, token, registry, entryRef, the leg's amount and kind = OpeningKind + 256 w (w = window: the auditor copy's j mod S_AUD, 0 for a receiver); pk the disclosing key, u = u_{j / s}, v = v_{a,j} (AUDITOR) or v_j (RECEIVER) of multi_case.
